scripts.merge:current-to-dev: node -e "const { execSync } = require('node:child_process'); const run = (c, inherit = true) => execSync(c, inherit ? { stdio: 'inherit', encoding: 'utf8' } : { encoding: 'utf8' }); const branch = run('git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD', false).trim(); if (!branch || branch === 'HEAD') throw new Error('Detached HEAD; cannot infer current branch'); const dirty = run('git status --porcelain', false).trim().length > 0; let stashed = false; try { if (dirty) { run(`git stash push -u -m \"auto-merge-current-to-dev:${branch}\"`); stashed = true; } run('git fetch origin'); if (branch === 'dev') { run('git push origin dev'); } else { run('git checkout dev'); run(`git merge ${branch}`); run('git push origin dev'); run(`git checkout ${branch}`); } } finally { if (stashed) { try { run('git stash pop'); } catch (e) { console.error('Warning: could not auto-pop stash. Resolve manually with: git stash list / git stash pop'); } } }"
